sections.content: How many people are "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors"?

38,255 people

were counted on the census as "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors oversee the activities of workers in skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors" there were more men than women (92.4% compared with 7.6%).

This means "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades".

Men made up 92.4% and women made up 7.6% of "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors" included:

  • IT network professionals
  • marine and waterways transport operatives
  • forestry and related workers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors", 14.3% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors" was 16 to 19 years.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors" included:

  • construction and building trades supervisors
  • social services managers and directors
  • construction project managers and related professionals

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

We can look at who worked as "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of women with this occupation than men.

The percentage of men and women who are "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades supervisors", 7.4% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (96% compared with 4%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (95.4%) than self-employed (4.6%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included County Durham, this is in the region of the North East.
